entities.name: Gyox
entities.description: Four-armed Phyrexian of New Phyrexia who hunted in the Hunter Maze for fodder for Sheoldred's coliseum.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Ruler of New Phyrexia whose respect Gyox earned.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Ruler of New Phyrexia for whom Gyox sought fodder.

entities.name: Hunter Maze
entities.description: Place Gyox stalked in search of fodder.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that Gyox may not have survived.

events.summary: Gyox slaughters enough of Vorinclex's champions to earn his respect.
events.quote: Having slaughtered enough of Vorinclex's champions to earn his respect, she stalked the Hunter Maze in search of worthy fodder for Sheoldred's coliseum.

relations.quote: had an affinity for both Vorinclex and Sheoldred during their rule of the plane
